findings.obs_text: The surface reason renders eighteen codes. As a noun of the mind it is G3056 in 1Pe 3:15 (an account given), H4486 in Dan 4:34 and Dan 4:36 (understanding restored) and G2138 in Jam 3:17 (open to persuasion); as a verb it is H3198 in Isa 1:18 (to argue a case together). Elsewhere it is part of a phrase of cause: H6440I in Gen 41:31, H5921A, H1697M, H3651C, G1223, G5124, G0156, G2596, G0302, G1352, G5484, G1519 and H1961, and H2600 in Job 1:9 for without cause.
The surface reasoned carries two codes: G1256 in Act 17:2, Act 17:17, Act 18:4, Act 18:19 and Act 24:25, where Paul discourses with others, and G3049 in 1Co 13:11, where a child reckons for himself.

The surface reasoning carries two codes: G1261 in Luk 9:47, the reasoning held within the hearts of the disciples, and G1256 in Act 19:8 and Act 19:9, where Paul argues with others in the synagogue and the hall of Tyrannus.
